author: Will_29
body:
There are four houses, four seasonal events each with their own rules.

The bosses for the current winter event can only be hit with spells. Physical attacks, summons, followers and indirect damage don't work because those are the ways to defeat the other three houses.

There is a house from another version of the event that is weak only to damage from summons and followers. There your build will thrive.
